# ona_team_membership (List Resource)

Lists user memberships in an Ona team.

## Example Usage

```terraform
list "ona_team_membership" "all" {
  provider         = ona
  include_resource = true
  config { team_id = "<team-id>" }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `team_id` (String) Team ID whose memberships are queried.
